policy.editing: PROPOSE-ONLY for the loop: an iteration may append to `proposals` with its failure evidence; only a human moves a proposal into `rungs` or flips `proven`.
policy.firstAscents: No unmanned first ascents: a rung with proven=false needs one supervised session that builds its probe/oracle and lands a clean scripted pass before autonomous iteration may run it.
policy.verification: Runtime evidence is mandatory; an unavailable oracle means UNVERIFIED, never PASSED. Any StudioAgentTest_* / TestAutoKill symbol in the artifact BLOCKS extraction.

rungs.brief: One-handed sword: primitive/mesh visual, make_tool (Handle at the hilt), bind_behavior (fast swing), bind_hitbox (short reach, moderate damage). VISUAL BAR: generate_mesh (Cube) + save_mesh — primitive-part weapons are below the bar; verify the silhouette by capture before toolifying.
rungs.oracle: playtest act record shows idle->windup->active->cooldown->idle at the CONFIGURED timings (the record echo names the tool + config); shit verb shows the TargetDummy losing exactly the configured damage once per swing.

rungs.brief: Spear: longer visual + LONGER REACH, slower swing (bigger windup/cooldown) than the sword — a variation of the proven melee family. VISUAL BAR: generate_mesh (Cube) + save_mesh — primitive-part weapons are below the bar; verify the silhouette by capture before toolifying.
rungs.oracle: same as weapon-sword, with reach > 6 and windup+cooldown slower than sword defaults; the record echo must name the spear tool.

rungs.brief: Dagger: short reach, very fast swing, low damage, fast server cooldown. VISUAL BAR: generate_mesh (Cube) + save_mesh — primitive-part weapons are below the bar; verify the silhouette by capture before toolifying.
A slow high-damage melee enemy: rig + make_npc with high damage, low speed, short detect range.
rungs.oracle: playtest snpc shows state=attack in range and the player losing the configured damage per cooldown.
